content: Josafat, Moab-sordamargi, degi, Amón-sordamargi nakwisad
We-ibmar-gusad-sorba, Moab-sordamar, Amón-sordamar, degi, abar Meunita-sordamar, bular-danimalad, Rey-Josafatʼgi bila-onogegar.

Degine, gwenna-gwenna Josafat-owisoapmalad, ega sogdapmalad: “Sordamar-bukidar Siria-yar-akale, Demar-Gagbid-obakar bebina itos danimarye. A-dulemar bato Hazezon-Tamarʼye-neg-nugadgi bukwamarye. We-negde Engadiʼye nugbalid.”
Josafat nue-dobe-ito-nadedba, na Bab-Jehováʼse idakded. Degine, Josafat, bela Judá-yargi gayaburba mimisad, Bab-Dummadse-golega mer mas-gunmaloye.
Geb degine, Judá-yargi bela neggwebur-baigangi-dulemar-bukwad nonimalad, adi, bulale, Bab-Jehováʼse bendakleged egisegar.
Geb degidgine, Josafat, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neggi, neg-imba-bini-naid-asabin gwisgusad, Judá-dulemar-asabin, degi, Jerusalénʼginmalad-asabin.
Sogded: “Anmar-dadgan-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼye, bee be nibneggi Bab-Dummadga maid. Bee be yarmar-baid-baid-nanaid semaid. Bee be gargandik maid. ¿Doa be-gangued-abin gwisguoe? Dule-gwisgued sate.
Anmar-Bab-Dummad, bee be Israel-dulemar-wagab, we-yargi dulemar-bukwad onisad. Bee, be-ai-Abraham-e-waganga, a-yar degisadegu ega be uksad.
Abraham-e-waganmar we-yargi-ambikunonimalad, degi, be-nuggi bese-goled-neg sobsamalad. ”Geb degine, sogdemalad:

‘Ar anmargi boni-dummad danikile, es-suidba-galitogeddibe, uelleged-dummaddibe, igi, ukud-dummaddibe, agi, anmar be-nuggi bese-goled-negse be-asabin bular ambikunonimalale, degi, wile-itogedba anmar binnasur bese gotemalale, be anmar-itogoed, be anmar-bendakoed.’

”Anmar-Israel-dadgan Egipto-yargi noarmargua, Amón-dulemar-yargi, Moab-dulemar-yargi, degi, Seir-yargi dogmalad be abessurgusad. Aka be anmar-dadgan baid-igarba be barmis gusad, adi, mer anmar-dadgan, we-dulemar-bukwad osulogegar.
Emidi, aka we-dulemardi be-anmarga-yar-uksadgi gandikidgi anmar-ononno-danimalad.
Anmar-Bab-Dummadye, ¿a-dulemar be apor-odurdakosurde? Ar anmardi we-sordamar-bukidaradgi bila-onogega gargangued sated. An wissurmalad, igi an imakmaloe. Degisoggu, bese an idakmarsundo.”
Bela Judá-dulemar, Bab-Jehová-asabin gwigwichimalad, e-omeganse-bakar, e-machimalase-bakar, degi, e-mimmi-bipiganase-bakar, gwigwis nanaed.
Geb degine, dulemar-igar-itobukwadgi Bab-Jehová-Burba, Zacarías-machi-Jahazielʼgi ubononikid.

Degi, Jahaziel sogded: “Rey-Josafat, nue itogo. Degine, Judá-dulemar, Jerusalén-dulemar, nue itomarmogo. Bab-Jehová weyob bemarga soged: ‘Mer sorda-bukidar-danikid-abin gwayemalo, mer dobgumalo. Ar bemar bila-onogosurmalad, ani an bila onogoed.
Banedse abin be aidedmalo. Sorda-bila-onomaladdi, Quis-yar-nakwilemaidgi nakwedanimaloed. Geb degine, Jeruel-neg-dulesulidganse-moed-iduar, dian-maidgi be a-sordamar-abingunonimaloed.

Bemardi, melle ese be achamalo. Bogi be ambikumalo. Be dakmaloed, ani, Bab-Jehová, igi an bemar-bendakoe. Judá-dulemar, degi, Jerusalén-dulemar, mer be dobgumalo, mer galakumalo. Banedse amar-abin be namalo, ar ade, ani, Bab-Jehová, an bemarba gudioed.’ ”
Degidgi, Josafat, degi, bela Judá-dulemar, degine, Jerusalén-dulemar Bab-Jehová-nug-odummogega napase dulluu Bab-Jehová-asabin imaksamalad.
Geb Levita-dulemar-Coat-e-wagan, degi, Levita-dulemar-Coré-e-wagan, gandikidgi Israel-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-nug-odummogega gwisgusmalad.

A-banedgine, Judá-sordamar wakudaryala gwisgusmargua, Tecoa-nega-dulesulidganba nadmarsunnad. Degi, sordamar-irmakmaidgine, Josafat gwisgusad, sogded: “Judá-dulemar, Jerusalénʼginmalad, nue itomalo: Bonisuli be gudii gumalagala, mer be be-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼgi bengumalo. Bab-Jehová-e-gayaburba-barsogmaladgi mer be bengumarbalo, adi, bega igar-nueganbi guegar.”
Geb degi, Josafat dulemarga ibmar-sogsad-sorba, dulemar susad, adi, amar Bab-Jehová-nug-odummogega, degi, sordamar-idumaidgi namakegar. We-namaklegedgi namakegar:

Judá-dulemar Bab-Jehová-nug-odummogega namakdemalad. Geb agine, Bab-Jehová, Amón-sordamar, Moab-sordamar, degi, Seir-Yar-sordamar Judá-dulemargi-bila-onogega-danimalad na muchub-muchub aibinmalaga e-igar oburusad. Deyobi, Bab-Jehová amar-ogalakusad.

Ar Amón-sordamar, Moab-sordamarbo, Seir-yarginmaladgi gwisgudmalad. Geb bela Seir-sordagan-ogilosmalad. A-sorbali, Amón-sordamar, degi, Moab-sordamar na muchub-muchub bela-osulogedse e-sordamar-ogilosmalad.

Geb degi, Judá-dulemar e-isdarmalad-bukidarad-dakega, nega-dulesulidganba nebasik ataknonimalad. Unnila dulemar-burgwar-burgwar napagi omilede dakarmalad. Wargwensaale gwen wakichasulid, bela burgwismalad.

Geb degine, Josafat, e-dulemarbo ibmar-nuegan-mileded-sunaega nadmarsunnad. Geb degi, burgwarmalad-abargi ibmar-nuegan-bukidar amismalad: Mormar-nuegan, ibmar-nuegan-yeerdaklemalad susmalad. Ar ibmar bukidarsoggu, geg bela seda gusmalad. Ibapaa ibmar-wenanai gusmalad, ar ade, ibmar yaisulid.
Ibabakegusgu, Beraca-nebagi bular ambikunonimalad. Agi, Bab-Jehová-nug-odummosmalad. Agala, a-neba Beraca-Nebaye onug-imaksamalad. We-garda-narmaklenaidse amba deyob nugad.
A-sorbali, bela Judá-dulemar, degi, Jerusalénʼginmalad, Josafat emar-idumai, weligwaledba Jerusalén-neggweburse gannar nonimalad. Ar ade, Bab-Jehová e-isdarmaladgi emar-bendaksad.
Degi, Jerusalénʼse nonimargu, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-negse nadmalad.
Dulemar wisgusgua, Bab-Jehová Israel-isdarmaladgi gwichigusye, bela we-napneggi dulemar-bukwad Bab-Jehová-dobgudmalad.
Geb degi, Josafat-negsemaidgi neg bogidik-nagunonikid, ar ade, Israel-Bab-Dummad bela neggwebur-iliba bogidikid neg-nasiksad.
Josafat-negsesad
Josafat birga-dulagwen-gakambe-gakatar-nikadgi (35), Judá-yar-sealid. Jerusalénʼgine birga-dulagwen-gakatar (25) negsesad. E-nandi Azubaʼye nugad Silhi-e-sisgwad.
Josafat, e-bab-Asa-nanasayob nanadii gusad. A-igargi gwen bangussulid. Degisoggu, ibmar-nueganbi Bab-Jehová-asabin imakdii gusad.
Degi-inigwele, bab-dummaganse-goled-aila-matusulid-bukwad osulossulid. Deunni, Judá-dulemardi e-gwagegi amba e-dadgan-e-Bab-Dummad yoo nue-napira amimalad.
Rey-Josafat ibmar-baigan imaksabalid. A-ibmar gebesaila-imakded-akale, e-berguedsega, Hanani-machi-Jehú-gardagi narmakar maid. Degine, Israel-reymar-garda-maidgi narmakar maibalid.
We-ibmar-nasad-sorba, Judá-rey-Josafat, Israel-rey-Ocozíasʼbo ai-nued gunonikid. Ocozíasʼde, dule-isganad.
Urmar-sobega na ebo atosmalad, adi, a-urmar Tarsis-yarse nanaegar. Ezión-Geber-neg-nugadgi urmar sobsamalad.

Degidgine, Maresaʼgined-Dodava-machi-Eliezer Josafatʼga sunmaknonikid, ega sogded: “Rey-Ocozíasʼbo be atossoggu, be ibmar-imaknaidi Bab-Jehová bei obelogoye.” A-ulale, e-urmar dogsad bela mamarnonikid. Tarsisʼse geg bar nae gussunnad.
